report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy and contradicts the alert: error_rate 0.001, p95 78ms, OK checkout span, 200 request logs, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. No downstream service telemetry is available to localize a fault, so no evidence-supported root-cause candidate can be established. Handing off for broader telemetry collection.
missing_evidence: Gateway telemetry shows healthy status (error_rate 0.001, p95 78ms, OK traces, 200 logs); no evidence of the alerted error-rate/latency spike.
No per-service metrics/traces for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, or redis to localize a downstream fault.
No error logs or failed spans to identify an http-500 or timeout source.
No db_pool_waiters/dependency_timeouts data for downstream services to assess db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout.
No deployment records or config-change evidence to assess bad-configuration.
No memory-retention time series to assess memory-leak.
